body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/31719

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2370

Candidate parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2280 at exact commit `4b0d2276a4cf6ce3e6ed5d2c7f66dce81416d0ac`

Independent review parent: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2335

## What changed

- Preserved the candidate's cast of tracked GDN conv snapshots to the configured cache dtype.
- When GDN prefill activations and conv-cache storage differ, gather only active slots, run the existing causal convolution in activation dtype with identity slot indices, and cast updated slots back to the configured storage dtype.
- Kept the existing direct path for same-dtype cache and activations.
- Added selected-slot/unit coverage and a real gfx950 regression with independent grouped-convolution output and final-state references.

## Failing before

I first applied the candidate commit unchanged to prepared base `358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365`.

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-badb4e8b86a3/venv/bin/python reports/j-badb4e8b86a3/reproduce_mixed_conv_dtype.py
```

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, the candidate's snapshot helper succeeded, but BF16 activations with FP32 and FP16 conv caches failed at the immediately following Triton `causal_conv1d_fn` compile with mismatched `new_conv_state` branch types. FP16 activation/BF16 cache and BF16/BF16 were successful controls. Raw compiler evidence is in `reports/j-badb4e8b86a3/candidate_before.txt`.

## Passing after

The same GPU boundary fixture now passes all four dtype combinations. It checks output and updated cache contents against a separate `torch.nn.functional.conv1d` grouped-convolution reference.

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-badb4e8b86a3/venv/bin/python reports/j-badb4e8b86a3/reproduce_mixed_conv_dtype.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-badb4e8b86a3/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_gdn_prefill_backend_policy.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-badb4e8b86a3/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/layers/mamba/test_causal_conv1d.py -k branches_from_cloned_query_state
```

Results: GPU fixture passed all four cases; policy suite passed 18 tests and 27 subtests; existing causal-convolution GPU regression passed. Repository pre-commit hooks passed for all changed files.

## Limitations

The reported QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights, NVIDIA RTX 5090, CUDA 13.3, and SM120 were unavailable. I did not claim full-model serving, semantic accuracy, NVIDIA coverage, or multi-node coverage. The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify qwen3_5 hybrid-GDN and was not substituted. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
